chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Hammad ibn Maymun, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who died and left behind his parents and siblings from the mother, he said: 'God, Glory be to Him, is more generous than to increase her share in maintenance (while alive) and decrease her share in inheritance by one-third.'
ai.seo_question: What is the mother's inheritance share when the deceased leaves parents and siblings from the mother?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the principle of 'generosity of the Divine' (Akram min an yuziydahā) regarding the mother's inheritance share when she is left with both parents and maternal siblings. The Imam clarifies that while the Quranic verse 4:11 typically reduces the mother's share to one-third in the presence of offspring or multiple siblings, here her share remains the standard one-sixth, as the 'reduction' mechanism applies specifically to the division of the remaining estate among heirs rather than diminishing her fixed portion. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the mother's one-sixth is a fixed entitlement in this specific configuration, preserved from further reduction by the 'residuary' logic that applies to other heirs.
